items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Well, Mandy, she was the mama. Well, now, she played piano in Annapolis.

ctx.x: She worked with lots of different shows, Emerson, Andy, and different ones.
